raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stacked on #45620; review the last commit.

## Motivation

With `--enable-session-radix-cache`, a finished request references the leaf its output ended on. Many multi-turn clients resend the conversation history on the next turn, with the assistant turn re-rendered, instead of extending the generated output. For those clients:

- each session keeps adding referenced dead branches;
- the window the next turn actually matches, at the end of the previous prompt, stays unreferenced;
- on hybrid sliding-window models with HiCache, the referenced dead branches fill the SWA host tier, and the windows the next turns need are evicted;
- after an idle gap, the next turn then recomputes its whole context.

This PR places a session's single reference at the end of its last prompt and releases its other references. Older prompt ends and outputs become ordinary LRU entries, evicted first on device and host. Server-managed sessions (`session_params`) extend the previous output, so they are unchanged.

Clients and proxies carry the conversation id in different headers. On top of #45620, which fills a missing `session_id` from `X-Session-ID`, the header name becomes configurable, as sgl-router's `--session-id-header` already is.

#45430 protects the prompt-end windows of running requests on device. This PR keeps a finished session's window on device and on the host tier, across idle gaps.

Related: #41865 refreshes a parent session's cached tail on subagent requests, and #35515 evicts a branch's trailing sliding window last in the SWA radix cache.

## How to enable

```bash
python -m sglang.launch_server ... --enable-session-radix-cache
SGLANG_OPT_SESSION_REF_PROMPT_TAIL=1            # default off
SGLANG_SESSION_ID_HEADER=x-my-session-header    # default x-session-id; empty disables the header
```

Requests carry a session id, either `session_id` in the body or the session header.

## Performance

Muse-Spark-Open NVFP4, 4x GB300, TP4/EP4, FP8 KV cache, DFLASH with 8 draft tokens, HiCache (write-back), at most 44 running requests. Multi-turn long-context sessions at concurrency 64; the client resends each conversation's history. Both arms run `--enable-session-radix-cache` with #45620 and the configurable header; the baseline leaves `SGLANG_OPT_SESSION_REF_PROMPT_TAIL` off. Both arms also run the KV split of #46082 and the draft KV on SWA slots of #46116.

| Concurrency | Throughput per GPU (tok/s), baseline | Throughput per GPU (tok/s), this PR | Per-user decode speed, P90 (tok/s/user), baseline | Per-user decode speed, P90 (tok/s/user), this PR | TTFT P90 (s), baseline | TTFT P90 (s), this PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 64 | 44,412 | 72,189 (+62.5%) | 24.84 | 49.96 (+101.1%) | 26.88 | 4.30 |

Throughput per GPU counts input and output tokens. Per-user decode speed excludes time to first token; P90 is the speed 90% of requests reach.

At concurrency 48 (at most 32 running requests), where host-cache pressure is low, this PR with #45620 and the header is within noise of sessions off: +1.6% throughput per GPU, +1.8% P90 per-user decode speed.

## Tests

`test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_session_unified_radix_cache.py`, 4 new CPU cases on FULL+SWA with a simulated host tier:
- each session holds one ref, at its last prompt end; with the flag off, refs pile up as before; close releases everything;
- after host SWA eviction, each session's next turn still hits its whole previous prompt;
- a turn anchored at the root releases the session's older ref;
- a server-managed session keeps its ref on the output.

`test/registered/cpu/test_request_headers.py`, 1 new case: a configured header replaces the default, and an empty value disables the fallback.

The model math is unchanged; only which prefixes hit the cache changes.

+def apply_session_id_header(obj, headers) -> None:
+    """Fall back to the ``SGLANG_SESSION_ID_HEADER`` header (``X-Session-ID`` by
+    default) when the body carries no session identity.
+
+    The body always wins: this only fills a missing ``session_id``, so a caller
+    that sets the field explicitly is unaffected. ``session_params`` describes a
+    scheduler-managed session and is mutually exclusive with ``session_id``, so
+    the header is ignored when ``session_params`` is present.
+    """
+    if getattr(obj, "session_id", None) is not None:
+        return
+    if getattr(obj, "session_params", None) is not None:
+        return
+    header = envs.SGLANG_SESSION_ID_HEADER.get()
+    value = headers.get(header) if header else None
+    if value:
+        obj.session_id = value
+

+FULL, SWA = ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.SWA
+
+
+class TestSessionRefPromptTail(UnifiedRadixCacheFixtures, CustomTestCase):
+    """SGLANG_OPT_SESSION_REF_PROMPT_TAIL, for clients whose next turn resends the
+    history (a re-rendered assistant turn) instead of extending the generated
+    output: every finished output is then a dead branch of its session."""
+
+    OUT = 6  # longer than window + page, so a stock SWA ref lands in the output
+    cfg = CacheConfig(
+        components=(FULL, SWA),
+        sliding_window_size=4,
+        kv_size=1024,
+        max_context_len=1024,
+    )
+
+    def _cache(self, *, prompt_tail: bool, page_size: int = 1):
+        # The kit's helpers read self.cfg.
+        self.cfg = dataclasses.replace(type(self).cfg, page_size=page_size)
+        with envs.SGLANG_OPT_SESSION_REF_PROMPT_TAIL.override(prompt_tail):
+            fx = build_fixture(self.cfg, enable_session_radix_cache=True)
+        # Host tier simulated at the tree level; host frees are bookkeeping only.
+        fx[0].tree_core.set_hicache_enabled()
+        fx[0].tree_core.has_swa_host_pool = True
+        return fx
+
+    def _finish(self, fx, session_id, prompt, output, managed=False):
+        """The post-prefill checkpoint, then the finished insert and the session
+        registration cache_finished_req makes; both inserts are page-aligned.
+        ``managed`` makes it a server-managed (session_params) session's request."""
+        cache, page = fx[0], self.cfg.page_size
+        if len(prompt) >= page:
+            self._insert(*fx, prompt[: len(prompt) // page * page])
+        tokens = prompt + output
+        leaf = self._insert(*fx, tokens[: len(tokens) // page * page]).last_device_node
+        req = SimpleNamespace(
+            session_id=None if managed else session_id,
+            session_generation=cache.ensure_session_generation(session_id),
+            session=(
+                SimpleNamespace(session_id=session_id, streaming=False)
+                if managed
+                else None
+            ),
+            origin_input_ids=array("q", prompt),
+            output_ids=array("q", output),
+            extra_key=None,
+        )
+        cache.session_refs.register_session_ref(req, leaf=leaf)
+
+    def _turns(self, fx, session_id, prompt, turns):
+        """Run ``turns`` turns; return the last prompt."""
+        for k in range(turns):
+            if k:
+                rerendered = [7000 + 100 * k + i for i in range(3)]
+                prompt = prompt + rerendered + [8000 + 100 * k + i for i in range(5)]
+            output = [9000 + 100 * k + i for i in range(self.OUT)]
+            self._finish(fx, session_id, prompt, output)
+        return prompt
+
+    def _nodes(self, cache):
+        root = cache.tree_core.root_node
+        return [n for n in cache.tree_core._node_arena.values() if n is not root]
+
+    def _end(self, cache, node):
+        end = 0
+        while node is not cache.tree_core.root_node:
+            end += len(node.key)
+            node = node.parent
+        return end
+
+    def _hit(self, cache, tokens):
+        m = cache.match_prefix(MatchPrefixParams(key=RadixKey(array("q", tokens))))
